evidence_basis: R6-v1 gpt-5.4-mini medium omitted one supported edge from a 70,470-byte two-objective core while preserving all 18 decisions.
R6-v1 both gpt-5.4-mini routes independently classified the explicitly non-authoritative stale count projection as resolved_difference.
R6-v1 Luna and the old R5 oracle retained an unresolved label, demonstrating semantic ambiguity in the old tension contract.

changes.change: Separate one-objective decision synthesis from one compact typed edge-verdict call.
changes.general_rule: Model objectives and candidate sets are data-driven; reducer owns order and joins.

changes.change: Route unsupported candidates to exclusion, explicitly authority/currentness-resolved candidates to deterministic resolved_difference, and only unresolved admitted candidates to a subject.
changes.general_rule: Unsupported precedence is evaluated before resolution; changed-ID/order/eligibility holdouts cover all routes.

downstream_invalidation: S10B selected_tension_ids changes from the R5/R6-v1 payload, so every causal descendant must be regenerated and freshly tested.
